summary: Iteration 10 Owner Portal (RBAC) fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass covering RBAC (401/403), /auth/me is_owner promotion via OWNER_MOBILE, owner users list (shape+sort), district analytics (totals+row sort), ads CRUD incl. invalid-district 400, PATCH toggle, public /api/ads district filter, feedback inbox aggregation. Frontend: Owner OTP login → Settings owner-portal-link visible → /owner tabs all render (50 users, 8 districts, existing ads, 12 feedback). Ad upload via ad-file-input + Mysuru chip + submit-ad-btn creates ad; del-ad-<id> after confirm removes it. Non-owner user: owner-portal-link hidden in /settings and /owner redirects to /dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1634 lines — approaching maintainability limits; consider splitting into routers (owner.py, ads.py, contractors.py, reports.py).

PATCH /api/owner/ads/{aid}?active=... uses a raw bool query param. Works, but exposing it as JSON body would be more RESTful and avoids client-side URL truthiness bugs (e.g., FastAPI accepts 'false'/'true' strings).
Owner ads DELETE does not verify ad ownership scoping — fine here since only owner can call it, but if RBAC ever loosens this is a foot-gun.
OwnerAds base64 size cap is 1.8 MB encoded; frontend caps at 1 MB unencoded — consistent, but no server-side content-type check on data URLs.
OTP `dev_otp` returned in response is intentional dev-mode but should be gated behind an env flag before production.
test_credentials: OTP dev flow. Owner mobile: 9700000030 (normalized 919700000030). Any other 10-digit number = non-owner. dev_otp is returned by /api/auth/otp/send.
seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed TEST_/TEST-. Ad TEST UI Ad created and deleted in same run; feedback TEST-fb entries persist for owner-inbox verification (safe to leave).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10_owner.py must be run with -n 0 (single worker) because scope=module owner OTP fixture races against xdist LoadScope splitting. All other iteration files still work in default parallel mode.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in Iteration 10.
